# netbox_asn_range (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get ASN range by name
data "netbox_asn_range" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

// Get ASN range by id
data "netbox_asn_range" "test_by_id" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
